title: Resolve a library, then read its docs
question: Find the Context7 library id for Next.js, then fetch its documentation on the app router.
why: Two calls where the second needs the first. This is the shape Anthropic measured on tau-squared-bench: scores unchanged, cost about 8 percent higher. Code mode buys nothing when there is nothing to loop over and nothing to filter. The program returns the whole document on purpose: truncating it would post a flattering ratio by throwing away the answer the task asked for.

expect.note: Deterministic substring grading. A model grading a model would put the thing under test inside the measurement. These strings were chosen from what the servers actually returned on 2026-09-21, so a server change makes the grade fail loudly rather than drift quietly.
